import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('an order', () => {
  describe('when it is paid', () => {
    it('records the payment date', () => {
      // given
      const clock = { now: () => new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') };
      const order = { paidAt: null as Date | null };

      // when
      order.paidAt = clock.now();

      // then
      expect(order.paidAt).toEqual(new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'));
    });

    it('keeps comments glued to the statement they describe', () => {
      // given
      const lines = [1, 2, 3];
      // when
      const total = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line, 0);
      // then
      expect(total).toBe(6);
    });
  });
});
